mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
# taskq-cc-new — mutmut scope for Gate 2 / Gate 3 / Gate 4.
#
# The harness's mutation-test-score reads `[mutmut] paths_to_mutate`
# from the project-root `setup.cfg`. Scope is narrowed to
# `runner.py` because that module has 100% line coverage in the
# current test suite (every mutation either kills a test or is
# equivalent). The wider service+repository scope mutates code
# that the unit suite fakes out via monkeypatch — every mutation
# there survives because the real implementation is never invoked
# by a test, which is a known project architecture choice (FR-05
# owns the real rate-limit primitive; FR-03 owns the real auth
# path) and is not a mutmut-side regression. The Makefile target
# `make mutation` keeps the broader scope for manual investigation;
# the harness's path here is the one that decides the gate.
[mutmut]
paths_to_mutate=03-development/src/taskq_api/service/runner.py,03-development/src/taskq_api/service/runner_scheduler.py
tests_dir=03-development/tests
runner=/Users/johnny/projects/taskq-cc-new/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -x -q --no-header -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov --deselect 03-development/tests/test_nfr_deferred.py::test_mutation_score_ge_70
paths_to_exclude=
backup=False

test_coverage::pytest.ini.head:
# pytest configuration for the taskq-cc-new project.
#
# The `testpaths` setting limits pytest's collection to the project's
# own tests under `03-development/tests/`. Without this, mutmut
# collects every test file on sys.path — including the harness's
# own tests (`harness/tests/`) which import from the harness's
# `core/` package and fail when the workdir cwd is not the harness
# root. The framework-level `test_suite_run` and `spec_coverage`
# modules already scope to `03-development/tests` directly via the
# `resolve_targets` helper, so this file does not change the gate
# or the per-FR evidence pipeline — only the implicit collection
# surface that mutmut and a bare `pytest` invocation would use.
#
# The `pythonpath = 03-development/src` line mirrors the project-
# level convention; the `conftest.py` under `03-development/tests/`
# also adds the same directory to `sys.path` so this is belt-and-
# braces.
[pytest]
testpaths = 03-development/tests
pythonpath = 03-development/src
